history.name: Two rules that keep sub-sections load-bearing
history.description: A sub-section has to hold at least four features, and none of them may be a Big one. Below four it isn't a section, it's three features that belong loose in their area; and since the heading and its overview already are the overview, a standalone capability sitting inside rebuilds the very wall the sub-section was there to break up. Both are judged over the finished shape of the record, so a sub-section can be declared and then filled.
history.dev_notes: FeatureSet#shapeProblems(), reported by `ledger check` and enforced by `ledger build` — deliberately not at load time. The minimum is configurable via min_subcategory_features.
